fact: In a meta-analysis of 13 SGLT2 inhibitor trials involving 90,409 participants, 74,804 (82.7%) had diabetes (>99% with type 2 diabetes) and 15,605 (17.3%) did not have diabetes.
fact_zh: 在一项纳入13项SGLT2抑制剂试验的荟萃分析中，涉及90,409名参与者，其中74,804人（82.7%）患有糖尿病（>99%为2型糖尿病），15,605人（17.3%）没有糖尿病。
quote: We identified 13 trials involving 90 413 participants. After exclusion of four participants with uncertain diabetes status, we analysed 90 409 participants (74 804 [82·7%] participants with diabetes [>99% with type 2 diabetes] and 15 605 [17·3%] without diabetes; trial-level mean baseline eGFR range 37–85 mL/min per 1·73 m 2 ).

fact: Compared with placebo, allocation to an SGLT2 inhibitor reduced the risk of kidney disease progression by 37% (relative risk [RR] 0·63, 95% CI 0·58–0·69) with similar RRs in patients with and without diabetes.
fact_zh: 与安慰剂相比，分配到SGLT2抑制剂可使肾脏疾病进展的风险降低37%（相对风险[RR] 0.63，95% CI 0.58–0.69），糖尿病患者和非糖尿病患者的RR相似。
quote: Compared with placebo, allocation to an SGLT2 inhibitor reduced the risk of kidney disease progression by 37% (relative risk [RR] 0·63, 95% CI 0·58–0·69) with similar RRs in patients with and without diabetes.

fact: SGLT2 inhibitors reduced the risk of acute kidney injury by 23% (0·77, 0·70–0·84) and the risk of cardiovascular death or hospitalisation for heart failure by 23% (0·77, 0·74–0·81), again with similar effects in those with and without diabetes.
fact_zh: SGLT2抑制剂使急性肾损伤的风险降低23%（0.77，0.70–0.84），心血管死亡或心力衰竭住院的风险降低23%（0.77，0.74–0.81），糖尿病患者和非糖尿病患者的效应相似。
quote: SGLT2 inhibitors reduced the risk of acute kidney injury by 23% (0·77, 0·70–0·84) and the risk of cardiovascular death or hospitalisation for heart failure by 23% (0·77, 0·74–0·81), again with similar effects in those with and without diabetes.

fact: SGLT2 inhibitors also reduced the risk of cardiovascular death (0·86, 0·81–0·92) but did not significantly reduce the risk of non-cardiovascular death (0·94, 0·88–1·02).
fact_zh: SGLT2抑制剂还使心血管死亡的风险降低（0.86，0.81–0.92），但未显著降低非心血管死亡的风险（0.94，0.88–1.02）。
quote: SGLT2 inhibitors also reduced the risk of cardiovascular death (0·86, 0·81–0·92) but did not significantly reduce the risk of non-cardiovascular death (0·94, 0·88–1·02).

fact: For all outcomes, results were broadly similar irrespective of trial mean baseline eGFR.
fact_zh: 对于所有结局，结果在试验平均基线eGFR方面总体相似。
quote: For all outcomes, results were broadly similar irrespective of trial mean baseline eGFR.

fact: The absolute benefits of SGLT2 inhibition outweighed any serious hazards of ketoacidosis or amputation.
fact_zh: SGLT2抑制的绝对获益超过了酮症酸中毒或截肢等严重危害。
quote: Based on estimates of absolute effects, the absolute benefits of SGLT2 inhibition outweighed any serious hazards of ketoacidosis or amputation.

fact: In the four chronic kidney disease trials, RRs were similar irrespective of primary kidney diagnosis.
fact_zh: 在四项慢性肾脏病试验中，RR在主要肾脏诊断方面相似。
quote: In the four chronic kidney disease trials, RRs were similar irrespective of primary kidney diagnosis.

fact: The majority of people with chronic kidney disease do not have diabetes, and thus more information about SGLT2 inhibitors in this patient group has particular public health importance.
fact_zh: 大多数慢性肾脏病患者没有糖尿病，因此关于这一患者群体中SGLT2抑制剂的更多信息具有特别的公共卫生重要性。
quote: The majority of people with chronic kidney disease do not have diabetes, and thus more information about SGLT2 inhibitors in this patient group has particular public health importance.

fact: EMPA-KIDNEY recruited 6609 patients with chronic kidney disease including 3569 patients without diabetes, and DELIVER recruited 6263 patients with heart failure with mildly reduced or preserved (>40%) ejection fraction including 3109 patients without diabetes.
fact_zh: EMPA-KIDNEY纳入了6609名慢性肾脏病患者，包括3569名无糖尿病患者，DELIVER纳入了6263名心力衰竭患者（射血分数轻度降低或保留>40%），包括3109名无糖尿病患者。
quote: EMPA-KIDNEY recruited 6609 patients with chronic kidney disease including 3569 patients without diabetes, and DELIVER recruited 6263 patients with heart failure with mildly reduced or preserved (>40%) ejection fraction including 3109 patients without diabetes.

fact: The current updated meta-analysis shows that in the studied patients with chronic kidney disease or heart failure (in whom chronic kidney disease was common), SGLT2 inhibitors safely reduced the risk of kidney disease progression by 37% (relative risk 0·63, 95% CI 0·58–0·69) and of acute kidney injury by 23% (0·77, 0·70–0·84), compared with placebo, with similar reductions in patients with and without diabetes.
fact_zh: 当前更新的荟萃分析显示，在研究的慢性肾脏病或心力衰竭患者（其中慢性肾脏病常见）中，SGLT2抑制剂与安慰剂相比，可安全地将肾脏疾病进展的风险降低37%（相对风险0.63，95% CI 0.58–0.69），急性肾损伤的风险降低23%（0.77，0.70–0.84），糖尿病患者和非糖尿病患者的降低幅度相似。
quote: The current updated meta-analysis shows that in the studied patients with chronic kidney disease or heart failure (in whom chronic kidney disease was common), SGLT2 inhibitors safely reduced the risk of kidney disease progression by 37% (relative risk 0·63, 95% CI 0·58–0·69) and of acute kidney injury by 23% (0·77, 0·70–0·84), compared with placebo, with similar reductions in patients with and without diabetes.

fact: Apparent benefits on kidney disease progression were also similar across the range of studied kidney function, and appeared unmodified by primary kidney diagnosis.
fact_zh: 在研究的肾功能范围内，肾脏疾病进展的明显获益相似，且不受主要肾脏诊断的影响。
quote: Apparent benefits on kidney disease progression were also similar across the range of studied kidney function, and appeared unmodified by primary kidney diagnosis.

fact: Two recent placebo-controlled SGLT2 inhibitor trials have provided important new information on the effects of SGLT2 inhibitors on kidney disease progression and other outcomes in patients without diabetes.
fact_zh: 两项最近的安慰剂对照SGLT2抑制剂试验提供了关于无糖尿病患者中SGLT2抑制剂对肾脏疾病进展和其他结局影响的重要新信息。
quote: Two recent placebo-controlled SGLT2 inhibitor trials have provided important new information on the effects of SGLT2 inhibitors on kidney disease progression and other outcomes in patients without diabetes.

fact: DELIVER randomly assigned 6263 patients with stable heart failure and an ejection fraction of greater than 40%, including 3109 (49·6%) patients without diabetes (mean estimated glomerular filtration rate [eGFR] 61 mL/min per 1·73 m 2 ), 4 and EMPA-KIDNEY randomly assigned 6609 patients with chronic kidney disease at risk of progression (mean eGFR 37 mL/min per 1·73 m 2 ), including 3569 (54·0%) without diabetes.
fact_zh: DELIVER随机分配了6263名稳定心力衰竭且射血分数>40%的患者，包括3109名（49.6%）无糖尿病患者（平均估算肾小球滤过率[eGFR] 61 mL/min per 1.73 m²），EMPA-KIDNEY随机分配了6609名有进展风险的慢性肾脏病患者（平均eGFR 37 mL/min per 1.73 m²），包括3569名（54.0%）无糖尿病患者。
quote: DELIVER randomly assigned 6263 patients with stable heart failure and an ejection fraction of greater than 40%, including 3109 (49·6%) patients without diabetes (mean estimated glomerular filtration rate [eGFR] 61 mL/min per 1·73 m 2 ), 4 and EMPA-KIDNEY randomly assigned 6609 patients with chronic kidney disease at risk of progression (mean eGFR 37 mL/min per 1·73 m 2 ), including 3569 (54·0%) without diabetes.

fact: Globally the majority of people with chronic kidney disease do not have diabetes.
fact_zh: 全球大多数慢性肾脏病患者没有糖尿病。
quote: Although geographical variation exists, globally the majority of people with chronic kidney disease do not have diabetes.

fact: The funders of the study had no role in study design, data collection, data analysis, data interpretation, or writing of the report.
fact_zh: 本研究的资助者在研究设计、数据收集、数据分析、数据解释或报告撰写中均无任何作用。
quote: The funders of the study had no role in study design, data collection, data analysis, data interpretation, or writing of the report.

fact: All 13 trials were judged to be at low risk of bias.
fact_zh: 所有13项试验均被认为偏倚风险较低。
quote: All 13 trials were judged to be at low risk of bias ( appendix p 13 ).

fact: Rates of outcome events were presented per 1000 patient-years.
fact_zh: 结局事件的发生率以每1000人年表示。
quote: Rates of outcome events were presented per 1000 patient-years.

fact: The main focus of efficacy analyses was on kidney disease progression, acute kidney injury, and a composite of cardiovascular death or hospitalisation for heart failure.
fact_zh: 疗效分析的主要重点是肾脏疾病进展、急性肾损伤以及心血管死亡或心力衰竭住院的复合终点。
quote: The main focus of efficacy analyses was on kidney disease progression, acute kidney injury, and a composite of cardiovascular death or hospitalisation for heart failure.
